name.title: Name
name.description: The name given to the dataset in a generic term. The name should be a meaningful, unique and unambiguous label. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the title.

description.title: Description
description.description: Information about the dataset as a free-text description. It is used only for a brief overview. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the description.
description.default: My Data Source contains mobility data about mobility things.

publisher_name.title: Publisher name
publisher_name.description: An entity (company and person) that publishes the dataset. This entity is responsible for the provisioning of a dataset. The entity also concludes a contract, if applicable.

mobility_theme_category.title: Mobility theme category
mobility_theme_category.description: Mobility-related theme categories (i.e., a specific subject, category, or type) of the delivered content. A dataset may be associated with multiple themes. A theme is important for data seekers who are interested in a particular type of data content. The theme is described via the mobilitydcatap:mobility-theme vocabulary in two hierarchy levels: this is the 1st level describing the classification of the data content on an aggregated level.

mobility_theme_subcategory.title: Mobility theme subcategory
mobility_theme_subcategory.description: Mobility-related theme sub-categories (i.e., a specific subject, category, or type) of the delivered content, The theme is described via the mobilitydcatap:mobility-theme vocabulary in two hierarchy levels: this is the 2nd level, an optional field detailing the category previously entered via one or several sub-categories.

accrual_periodicity.title: Accrual periodicity
accrual_periodicity.description: How often the content of the data source is updated. Select from the EU Publications Office frequency authority vocabulary.

language.title: Language
language.description: Languages of the data in the data source. Select from the EU Publications Office language authority vocabulary.

spatial_coverage.description: The geographical coverage of the data in the data source (IRI or free text).
spatial_coverage.title: Area covered

distributions.title: Distributions
distributions.description: A specific representation of the dataset (dcat:Distribution).

data_schema.title: Data schema/model
data_schema.description: The data schema/model adopted to represent the data. Select from the mobilitydcatap:mobilityDataStandard vocabulary.

format.title: Resource format
format.description: The format used to encode the data. Select from the EU Publications Office file-type authority vocabulary.

rights.title: Rights
rights.description: The rights associated with the data. Select from the mobilitydcatap:conditions-for-access-and-usage vocabulary.

access_url.title: Access URL
access_url.description: URL redirecting to a webpage or an endpoint to access the data.
